summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing it regained compliance with NYSE continued listing standards after filing delinquent periodic reports. The company had delayed its 2024 20-F due to an auditor change but filed it on February 17, 2026, within an NYSE extension through April 30, 2026. On April 30, 2026, it also filed semi-annual financials for the period ended June 30, 2025, becoming current with SEC filings. The NYSE confirmed compliance and will remove the late-filer indicator. No specific deal terms, financial consideration, or board recommendations are provided. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation.
